description: Trend per API in 5-minute buckets over a time window: calls, 5xx errors, auth failures, throttled calls and p95 response latency (ms) per bucket. Use for 'when did errors or slowness start/stop', 'error trend', 'latency trend', 'incident timeline'. Every bucket with traffic is returned.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_response, apim_event_faulty | WHERE DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes | EVAL bucket=DATE_TRUNC(5 minutes, requestTimestamp) | STATS calls=COUNT(*), errors_5xx=SUM(CASE(proxyResponseCode >= 500, 1, 0)), auth_failures=SUM(CASE(errorType == "AUTH", 1, 0)), throttled=SUM(CASE(errorType == "THROTTLED", 1, 0)), p95_ms=PERCENTILE(responseLatency, 95) BY bucket, apiName | SORT bucket ASC, apiName ASC | LIMIT 500

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
